prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for photo upload screen: Reorganizes the custom pet photo upload step into a two-column view separating upload guidelines from the visual image selector.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Your Custom Pet Photo", "hint": "Follow requirements for best results"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet naming ceremony interactive step: Inserts a dedicated pet naming screen before adoption certificate generation to increase user connection with their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_naming", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Give Your Pet a Name", "body": "Choose a unique name for your new desktop companion.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "style": "large"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Name", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesigns the custom photo upload screen into a list layout with explicit photo quality criteria and visual guidelines.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Custom Pet Photo Checklist", "body": "Ensure clear lighting and single subject for best generation accuracy."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after pick friend screen: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet companion, securing authentication before photo upload.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Stall prevention load hint on sign-in screen: Adds an inline status hint reassuring users while sign-in credentials and network connection are verified.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Connecting securely to server. Please hold on if authentication takes a moment."}}
5: [home, notification] Desktop pet spawn alert notification on waiting screen: Adds a sound and visual completion alert toggle on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play chime on completion", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [choose_path, new_screen] Path preview showcase screen before selection: Inserts a path showcase screen presenting visual comparisons between preset adoption and custom pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_showcase", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_showcase": {"headline": "Explore Companion Options", "body": "Pick between quick instant adoption or creating a custom AI pet.", "layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Explore Paths", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet control keymap hint on home intro screen: Displays a control quick-reference hint box explaining key bindings and tray menu controls on the final intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to toggle pet controls or right-click system tray."}}
8: [finish, redesign] Card layout redesign for home intro screen: Converts the final home intro screen into structured cards outlining controls, interactions, and settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Review desktop controls and interaction tips before jumping in."}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Mascot guidance hint on story screen: Adds a friendly mascot tip box on the story screen highlighting desktop companion benefits before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Your desktop companion will live right on your screen to help you daily!"}}
